title: Coordinate-swapped diagram of functorial hypercohomology pages
statement: Given a small cofiltered scheme diagram D with cone c [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], bounded-below complexes F_i of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with unital composable inverse-image maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], a compatible pullback diagram G, and a cocone L with bounded-below vertex, suppose presentations T0 and page maps M satisfy the first-page, identity, and composition equations of [lem-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-e1-pullback-functorial]. For any integers p,q, there exist a functor E on I.op, a limit spectral sequence Eprime and compatible comparison maps, obtained by swapping the two bidegree coordinates. Their first pages are ordinary termwise sheaf cohomology, with exactly the pullback-transition and cocone comparison equations, and vanish in negative resolution degree. For every page r>=1, there are isomorphisms from the (p-q,q) terms to the (q,p-q) terms of T0 at the stages and vertex; the transition and comparison maps commute with these isomorphisms and the specified M maps. No stable-page or filtration assertion is included.

proof.text: Apply the supplied page-map coherence lemma for identity, composition and cocone laws. Construct the unswapped functor R explicitly from T0 and M, using these laws.

Construct the coordinate swap embedding of up(1-r,r) into up(r,1-r). Restrict every page and page morphism. Use Mathlib restrictionHomologyIso and prove its naturality by cancelling homology pi and cycle inclusions. These constructions give a spectral-sequence swap functor. Compose R with it, and restrict the explicit vertex sequence and comparison maps.

The restricted page objects and page-map components are definitionally the original objects and components in the swapped bidegree. Use the supplied firstPageIso and hfirst for both first-page equations, the presentation negative field for vanishing, and identity isomorphisms for pageIso and pageIsoLimit. The two page naturality equations reduce to identity composition and reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: Explicit coordinate-swap restriction construction; scheme coherence split off separately.

mathlib_searches.results: UNAVAILABLE: Internal Server Error; local source grep and LeanFinder used instead.

mathlib_searches.query: A lower bounded complex has uniform stable hypercohomology spectral sequence pages natural for pullback
mathlib_searches.results: DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE; CochainComplex.cm5b; CochainComplex.isZero_of_isLE. These are support and resolution lemmas, not the functorial page package.

Mathlib SpectralSequence.Basic has page functors and hom_ext but no coordinate-swap functor. IsColimit.isZero_pt and isColimitOfPreserves prove the colimit bound. Existing pullback presentations have object-dependent thresholds without a uniform estimate.

mathlib_searches.query: Reindex a spectral sequence by exchanging the two integer indices and preserve naturality of page maps
mathlib_searches.results: Independent second reader: HomologicalComplex₂.flipFunctor and flipEquivalence handle bicomplexes, not arbitrary supplied spectral sequences; no exact match. Local SpectralSequence.Basic inspection confirms no swap functor.
